description: Find text by paragraph or character style (and optionally by text) in the document or one story, and change it to another paragraph or character style (Find/Change with Find Format and Change Format styles). Without change, only counts the matches

change.description: What to change matches to; leave out to only find

characterStyle.description: Character style to apply: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

paragraphStyle.description: Paragraph style to apply: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

find.description: What to find; give at least one

characterStyle.description: Character style to find: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

paragraphStyle.description: Paragraph style to find: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

text.description: Text to find (empty finds any text with the styles)

frameId.description: Search only the story of this text frame (default: the whole document)
